Missing object SHA: `a3b428442917d3cfbd06a7d928a9a0dbd1f159e4`. Per operator protocol I am not attempting server-side repair; hairstreak remains committed locally as `ea7c7beb6732a9372f328c252232ec0b2ee66865` and will need push retry after the Gerrit object store is repaired.
